# Pearl Nails & Spa

> Nail salon based in Austin, Texas. Pearl Nails & Spa is a calm, spotless South Austin salon where the owner and techs like Lee and Kim do natural-looking acrylics, almond French sets and pedicures that keep regulars coming back for years.

- Phone: (512) 292-9834
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Yelp rating: 3.7 from 111 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/pearl-nails-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/pearl-nails-spa/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic, gel and shellac manicures with clean cuticle work and even polish.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with soak, scrub and massage.
- Dip & full sets: Dip powder (SNS), acrylic full sets and fills in any shape.
- Nail art: French tips, chrome, seasonal designs and art copied from your photo.

## About
Pearl Nails & Spa is a strip-center nail salon on South IH-35, easy to find and easy to park. The owner works the floor herself, alongside techs including Lee and Kim. Reviewers say it isn't about fountains or fancy drinks. It's about great manicures, a huge polish wall, a calming room and a team that works hard. Some clients have come with their moms for seven years.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at Pearl Nails & Spa?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call (512) 292-9834 or book online.
- Q: Where is Pearl Nails & Spa?
  A: 11215 S IH 35, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about Pearl Nails?
  A: Pearl Nails & Spa is rated 3.7 stars from 111 Yelp reviews. Clients mention spotless stations, natural-looking sets and an owner who takes care of her clients.
